name: Jobless Interview
source:
Alex desperately needs a job. Luckily for him, his mother found a nice place for him, but he still has to be interviewed! The interviewer is strange and has a few... quirks.

Will Alex land the job or will he be sent back out to his abusive mother? Choose carefully and hope for the best. 

[From [url=https://studiovamp.itch.io/jobless-interview]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亚历克斯迫切需要一份工作。幸运的是，他的母亲为他找到了一个好地方，但他仍然需要接受采访！面试官很奇怪，有一些……怪癖。

亚历克斯会找到工作还是会被送回他虐待他的母亲身边？仔细选择并希望得到最好的结果。

[来自[url=https://studiovamp.itch.io/jobless-interview]Itch.io[/url]]
